title: 1023. Shape Area and Circumference

. 
Shape Area and Circumference

Easy
Problem Statement:
Write a C program to get various shape information (Circle, Square, Rectangle, etc.,) and print the area and circumference. 
Input Description:
The first line of the input consists of the current chosen choice integer C. Below is the corresponding choice for each shape.
1 - Circle
2 - Square
3 - Rectangle
The second line of the input consists of dimensions of the selected shape separated by space. Depending upon the chosen shape the below input varies as follows:
Circle:
The second of the input will consist of a single integer value R denoting the radius of the circle
Rectangle:
The second of the input will consist of two integer values L and B denoting the length and breadth correspondingly separated by space
Square:
The second of the input will consist of a single integer value A denoting the length of each square side. 
Output Description:
The first line of the output should be the area of the given shape
The second line of the output should be the circumference of the given shape
Note: Round the Decimal values to two decimal places. 
Explanation:
Self Explanatory 
Sample Input:
1
3 
Sample Output:
28.27
18.85
